title: Pure Hex Sealed Fusion
summary: The Hex-Sealed Fusion strategy centers around The Dark, The Light, and The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion—versatile Rock monsters that serve as named Fusion substitutes or Tribute themselves alongside field materials to cheat out Fusion bosses without Polymerization. Supported by Keeper of Dragon Magic, Fallen of Albaz, and Adamancipator Signs, the deck rapidly deploys devastating bosses like Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon, Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon, and Millennium-Eyes Restrict.

allow.Fallen of Albaz: Level 4 DARK Dragon: fuses with an opponent's monster on Summon, OR pairs on the field with The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion to Tribute both and cheat out Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.
allow.Albion the Shrouded Dragon: Level 8 DARK Dragon that Special Summons itself from the hand/GY by sending Branded Retribution/Albaz to GY, providing a free Dragon Effect Monster on the field to Tribute alongside Hex-Sealed Fusions.
allow.Keeper of Dragon Magic: Level 4 DARK Dragon that searches Polymerization and revives a named Fusion Material from the GY, AND serves as a Dragon on the field to Tribute with The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon.
allow.Doki Doki: Level 2 EARTH Rock that discards a Rock (a Hex-Sealed Fusion) to Special Summon The Light, The Dark, or The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion directly from your Deck matching the discarded Attribute.
allow.Adamancipator Signs: Revives any Rock monster (The Light, The Dark, or The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion!) from your GY and stacks another Hex-Sealed Fusion on top of your Deck.
allow.Polymerization: Searched by Keeper of Dragon Magic; allows the Hex-Sealed Fusions to Fusion Summon from the hand or field into bosses that require a proper Fusion Summon.
allow.Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon: Level 8 DARK Spellcaster Fusion boss that can be Special Summoned directly from the Extra Deck without Polymerization by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any Dragon Effect Monster on the field.
allow.Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon: Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Fusion boss summoned without Polymerization by Tributing The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any Dragon on the field.
allow.Millennium-Eyes Restrict: Level 1 DARK Spellcaster Fusion boss summoned without Polymerization by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any Effect Monster on the field to absorb and negate opposing monsters.
allow.Invoked Caliga: Level 4 DARK Beast Fusion boss summoned by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any DARK monster on the field to restrict both players to 1 monster effect and 1 attack per turn.
allow.Invoked Mechaba: Level 9 LIGHT Machine Fusion boss summoned via Polymerization using The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any LIGHT monster for omni-negation.
allow.Lubellion the Searing Dragon: Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Fusion summoned via Fallen of Albaz + 1 DARK monster to shuffle materials into the Deck for Fusion Summons.
allow.Ryu Senshi: Level 6 EARTH Warrior Fusion boss summoned by Tributing The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion + a Warrior/Fiend on field to negate Normal Traps and targeting Spells.
allow.Cyber Twin Dragon: Cyber Twin Dragon: Endboard boss featured on page analysis.
allow.Red-Eyes Slash Dragon: Red-Eyes Slash Dragon: Endboard boss featured on page analysis.
allow.Albion the Branded Dragon: Albion the Branded Dragon: Endboard boss featured on page analysis.

main: Level 3 DARK Rock: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material, OR tributes itself + 1 other material on the field without Polymerization to Special Summon Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon, Millennium-Eyes Restrict, or Invoked Caliga!
Level 3 LIGHT Rock: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material, OR tributes itself + 1 Dragon on the field without Polymerization to Special Summon Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon!
Level 3 EARTH Rock: substitutes for any 1 named Fusion Material, OR tributes itself + 1 other material on the field without Polymerization to Special Summon an EARTH Fusion Monster.

Level 4 DARK Dragon Effect Monster: discards 1 card on Normal/Special Summon to search Polymerization, AND serves as the exact '1 Dragon Effect Monster' on the field to Tribute alongside The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion for Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon!
Level 4 DARK Dragon Effect Monster: fuses with an opponent's monster into Lubellion, or Tributes on the field with a Hex-Sealed Fusion.
Level 8 DARK Dragon Effect Monster: sends Fallen of Albaz from Deck to GY to Special Summon itself from hand, giving you a free Dragon on the field to Tribute alongside a Hex-Sealed Fusion!
Level 2 EARTH Rock: discards 1 Rock monster to Special Summon a Rock monster with the same Attribute and Level from your Deck.
Special Summons any Rock monster (The Dark, The Light, or The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion) from your GY with 0 Normal Summon cost.
Searched by Keeper of Dragon Magic; fuses a Hex-Sealed Fusion with another material from your hand or field to Fusion Summon Invoked Mechaba, Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon, or Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon.
extra: 3000 ATK DARK Fusion boss: summoned either by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + 1 Dragon Effect Monster on the field (no Polymerization needed!), via Polymerization, or via Lubellion; cannot be targeted or destroyed by card effects and discards 1 card for an omni-negate.

3400 ATK LIGHT Dragon Fusion boss: summoned by Tributing The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion + 1 Dragon on the field (no Polymerization needed!) or via Polymerization; unaffected by Trap Cards and attacks all opponent's monsters.

Level 1 DARK Fusion boss: summoned by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + ANY Effect Monster on the field (no Polymerization needed!); equips an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect when they activate a monster effect.

Level 4 DARK Fusion boss: summoned by Tributing The Dark - Hex-Sealed Fusion + any DARK monster on the field (no Polymerization needed!) to restrict both players to 1 monster effect and 1 attack per turn.
Level 9 LIGHT Machine Fusion boss: summoned via Polymerization using The Light - Hex-Sealed Fusion + another LIGHT monster; discards a card type to negate and banish that card type.
Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Fusion summoned via Fallen of Albaz + a DARK monster; discards 1 card to shuffle materials from your field/GY into the Deck for Fusion Summons.
Level 6 EARTH Warrior Fusion boss for The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion that negates Normal Traps and targeting Spells.
Level 8 Fusion: 2800 ATK machine that attacks twice during each Battle Phase.
Level 7 Fusion: equips Warriors from GY when a Red-Eyes attacks, and sends equipped cards to negate cards/effects that target your cards.
Level 8 Fusion: performs a Fusion Summon on summon by banishing materials from hand, field, or GY; sets a Branded Spell/Trap in End Phase.
